353:t_2:97.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Now that's settled, I can't stay in this plug suit forever. I'll get them to find me a change of clothes.」

353:t_2:98.en:
$$アスカ$$
「And listen. Explaining how many years have passed since then is a pain, so you don't need to tell them.」

353:t_2:100.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We're guests in this world. So... I don't intend to get any closer to them than necessary.」

353:t_2:101.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I see... You're a kind girl.」

353:t_2:103.en:
$$マリ$$
「Prin-cess. You know what he's like now, so don't rise to it.」

353:t_2:106.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Brat $$シンジ$$, a knockoff Teacher's Pet, and a smart aleck...! Thinking about what's ahead gives me a headache...!」

353:t_2:107.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Where... should I go, and what should I do...?)

353:t_2:109.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Father, $$ミサト$$, $$カヲル$$... Tell me... Someone...)

353:t_2:114.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(...There's no sign of tampering with $$ヴェーダ$$. Even $$サイデリアル$$ probably couldn't analyze it in such a short time...)

353:t_2:115.en:
$$ティエリア$$
($$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s founder, $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$...)

353:t_2:116.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(He foresaw $$イノベイター$$s, preparing $$ＧＮ粒子$$ and $$イノベイド$$s to awaken them. He's clearly connected to $$クロノ$$...)

353:t_2:117.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(The data in $$ヴェーダ$$'s deepest reaches must contain his true intentions, and the truth about $$クロノ$$...)

353:t_2:118.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(I still can't access it... But someday, I'll reach it. I swear it.)

353:t_2:119.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(That's my role in supporting an $$イノベイター$$... in supporting $$刹那$$.)

353:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems your discussion is over, $$アスカ$$.」

353:t_10:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... You're as familiar as ever.」

353:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「First, allow me to congratulate you on your recovery, $$アスカ$$. I... always believed we'd meet again.」

353:t_10:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Recovery, huh... If you really think I'm back to normal, you're awfully carefree.」

353:t_10:8.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Do you want me to show you what's under it?」

353:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As the saying goes, 'Concealment makes the flower; revealed, it is no flower'... So I shall decline.」

353:t_10:10.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You're as slick as ever, too.」

353:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But you're much the same, $$アスカ$$. You said such awful things about $$シンジ$$, but...」

353:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When the four EVAs shot down enemies, warm feelings welled up in your heart, didn't they?」

353:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no use denying it. I'll add the 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s you produced to the unit's stock.」

353:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「'Concealment makes the flower'... Rest assured, I have no intention of revealing your deepest feelings to anyone.」

353:t_10:23.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Please don't be so wary. We're going to be comrades working together from now on.」

353:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have no intention of causing unnecessary trouble, but...」

353:t_10:25.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I think that's best. Interfering too much with events is dangerous.」

353:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Coming from you, those words aren't very convincing...」

353:t_10:27.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'm sorry. Then I'll make amends in my own way.」

353:t_10:28.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Then let's get fired up today, too... Business, business. ...Will that do?」

353:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You said my catchphrase without being taught it!」

353:t_10:30.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I don't know as much as you, but I do know a few things myself...」

354:t_001:0.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「The deep-space mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$...」

354:t_001:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「They're not even using optical camouflage... Were they not expecting us to approach...?」

354:t_001:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$'s main system is in there.」

354:t_001:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now we're here, there's only one thing to do. Let's get aboard and take it back, quick and easy.」

354:t_001:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're awfully fired up, $$ランド$$. You volunteered to team up with $n right before we launched.」

354:t_001:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「As his master, I figured I ought to drill that smile into him in the field!」

354:t_001:6.en:
$$甲児$$
(It seems $$ランド$$ noticed $n's still unsure of himself, too.)

354:t_001:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
(He looks rough and overbearing, but he's surprisingly thoughtful.)

354:t_001:9.en:
$$メール$$
「You're not there yet, $n. You've got to get more fired up to approach Darling's $$ヒートスマイル$$.」

354:t_001:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「$n learning the $$ヒートスマイル$$...」

354:t_001:11.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The girls in $n's secret fan club at $$陣代高校$$ would scream and cry.」

354:t_001:12.en:
$$シン$$
「There's a fan club like that?!」

354:t_001:16.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Are you sure, $n? If you stop being the quiet type, those girls might be disillusioned instead.」

354:t_001:17.en:
$n
「Then I'll make them swoon with my new charms.」

354:t_001:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「Your wording's a little dated, though.」

354:t_001:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「This guy... First older women, and now he's finally sinking his fangs into high school girls...」

354:t_001:21.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's enough chatter. We're starting the operation.」

354:t_001:22.en:
$$桂$$
「We'll have to thank $$クィーン$$ for this.」

354:t_001:23.en:
$$刹那$$
「It's too early to decide that.」

354:t_001:24.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The interception force has come out...!」

354:t_002:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$欲深な金牛$$, $$ストラウス$$...!」

354:t_002:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「They were here, just as I thought...」

354:t_002:4.en:
$n
「$$ランド$$, did you sense they were here?」

354:t_002:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah... And I feel like I'm the one who has to fight them.」

354:t_002:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Empire's Supreme Commander is out on the edge of the $$地球圏$$...!」

354:t_002:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「They've brought $$ダバラーン$$ and a fleet with them.」
